The '''Stromgarde Militia'''<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|40+|Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest}}</ref> is the force protecting [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]]. The crimson-clad defenders are known for the martial discipline in battle and has proven themselves in the [[Second War]] which they were able to hold off the entire Horde for quite a while on their own, allowing the rest of the Alliance to mobilize.<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]''</ref> Possessing a long history of warfare against the trolls, their warriors are well prepared to engage in open combat with all enemies of humanity.<ref>''Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness'' manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_II:_Tides_of_Darkness_manual#Stromgarde Nations of the Alliance]''</ref> Members of the Stromgarde Militia can be identified by their [[Stromgarde Badge]]s.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|37|Stromgarde Badges}}</ref>

Following the [[Third War]] and the fall of Stromgarde, the militia still exists and is based in [[Refuge Pointe]], while a contingent of their defenders are also firmly entrenched in the [[Gallant Square]] district of [[Stromgarde Keep]] itself.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|42+|Sigil of Trollbane (quest)|Sigil of Trollbane}}</ref> The capital is a battlefield where they face the [[Witherbark]] trolls, the [[Boulderfist]] ogres, and the criminals of the [[Syndicate]].
